name: LastPass
description: LastPass (a product of LogMeIn) is a freemium password manager that stores encrypted passwords online.

events.d: Add a new user to your LastPass company and invite them or stage the account.
Permanently delete a user by user ID or email from your LastPass company.
Update the name of an existing LastPass user using their user ID or email.
List LastPass users or a specific user. Filter by status, name, or email, and set max results.
Send an activation invitation to a user by email.
